Mountain Meanders

Mountain Meanders is a free guide to hiking, scrambling and easy climbing routes in the Western Cape of South Africa. The site contains route descriptions, maps, GPS tracks, photographs and safety information for Table Mountain, the Cape Peninsula, the Cederberg, Jonkershoek, the Hex River Mountains and many other areas. 

New to Mountain Meanders or a visitor to the Cape?   Read the Introduction

Key recent changes: 

  • Jan 2026 New Route: Corridor Face

  • Dec 2025 A new route!  Separation Buttress SW Diagonal.  A grade 5 ****, so a worthy addition

Future additions or changes will be posted in mountain-meanders@googlegroups.com.  This is a mailing list (with a low frequency of posting) which any user of mountain-meanders can join if they wish to be notified.  

To join, send an email to: mountain-meanders+subscribe@googlegroups.com
